product.name: Web Presence Review
product.description: Analyzes a merchant's website and online reputation by evaluating hundreds of risk signals to provide a pass/fail risk assessment and detailed merchant profile in under 30 seconds.

product.name: Merchant Monitoring
product.description: Provides ongoing monitoring of merchants to detect changes in risk profile and identify fraudulent or high-risk behavior after onboarding.

product.name: Risk Sharing Network & Smart Blocklist
product.description: Maintains a proprietary database of known fraudulent companies and shares risk information among participants to prevent onboarding of high-risk merchants.
